**Is this the root folder or a subfolder?**
This is a **subfolder**. The title at the top of the file list clearly reads **"Ressources"**, indicating that you are currently inside a folder with that name, rather than at the root level of the drive (which would typically be labeled "My Drive" or "我的雲端硬碟").

**Are the specific folder names visible?**
**Yes.** All five of the requested folder names—**Articles, images, Livres, Prompting,** and **sites**—are clearly visible in the list.

**Additional UI Elements:**
*   **Top Right:** A Google Apps launcher menu is open, displaying icons for various Google services such as Account (帳戶), Search (搜尋), Maps (地圖), YouTube, News (新聞), Gmail, Meet, Chat, Contacts (通訊錄), Drive (雲端硬碟), Calendar (日曆), Play, Docs, Photos, etc.
*   **Top Right Button:** A blue "Sign In" (登入) button.
*   **Menu Text:** There is text above the app icons stating "登入便可將應用程式排序" (Sign in to sort applications).
